before.one_line: QVPO (NeurIPS 2024): Q-weighted variational loss plus entropy regularization and an efficient behavior policy trains diffusion policies in online RL; state-of-the-art reward and sample efficiency on MuJoCo.

fields.one_line: QVPO (NeurIPS 2024): Q-weighted variational loss plus entropy regularization and an action-selected behavior policy trains diffusion policies in online RL; authors report improved reward and sample efficiency over their MuJoCo baselines.

evidence: Abstract and Sections 4–5 specify Q-weighted variational optimization, the entropy term and action-selected behavior policy, with MuJoCo comparisons. Attribute the SOTA claim to the paper’s evaluated baselines rather than imply present-day superiority.

before.one_line: Online RL (DACER) using the diffusion reverse process as the policy, with GMM-estimated entropy tuning exploration noise; state of the art on most MuJoCo benchmarks.

fields.one_line: Online RL (DACER) uses the diffusion reverse process as the policy, with GMM-estimated entropy tuning exploration noise; authors report leading results among their baselines on most tested MuJoCo benchmarks.

evidence: Abstract and entropy-regulator method estimate diffusion-policy entropy with a fitted GMM and adapt output exploration noise. MuJoCo results support the authors’ benchmark claim, but not unqualified current SOTA.

Abstract and Figure 1 specify active pairwise clip preferences, replay relabeling after reward-model changes and unsupervised exploration pretraining. Existing repository README points to a newer official BPref location.
